title: Transfer Lock Periods and Authorisation Code Validity — Domain Registrations
content:
# Transfer Lock Periods and Authorisation Code Validity — Domain Registrations

Transfers desk matrix. Lock periods are calendar days counted from the anchor date named in each column; a value of 0 means no such period applies.

| TLD product | Outbound transfer may start in the renewal grace period | Lock after the registration date | Lock after an inbound transfer completes | Lock after a change of registrant | Registrant may opt out of the change-of-registrant lock | Authorisation code valid for | Pending outbound transfer auto-approved after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | Yes | 60 days | 60 days | 60 days | No | 14 days | 5 days |
| .ca Domain Registration | No | 60 days | 60 days | 0 (none) | No | 14 days | 0 (completes on the request) |
| .com Domain Registration | Yes | 60 days | 60 days | 60 days | Yes | 14 days | 5 days |
| .org Domain Registration | Yes | 60 days | 60 days | 60 days | Yes | 14 days | 5 days |
| .net Domain Registration | Yes | 60 days | 60 days | 60 days | Yes | 14 days | 5 days |
| .co Domain Registration | No | 60 days | 60 days | 0 (none) | No | 14 days | 5 days |
| .io Domain Registration | No | 60 days | 60 days | 0 (none) | No | 14 days | 5 days |

**Inbound transfers of a domain that is in redemption at the losing registrar:** not accepted on any TLD product of Domain Registrations (.us, .ca, .com, .org, .net, .co and .io all No).

## Reading the matrix

- The auto-approval column is counted from the gaining registrar's request; a .ca Domain Registration shows 0, so its outbound transfer completes on the request itself.
- The change-of-registrant lock exists only where the column shows 60 days; on .com, .org and .net the registrant may opt out at the time of the change, while on .us the lock cannot be opted out of.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical .org Domain Registration registered on 10 January 2029 is inside its 60-day post-registration lock through 11 March 2029, the 60th day after the registration date; the first day outside it is 12 March 2029.
